response: Controlled ovarian stimulation (COS) in intrauterine insemination (IUI) is not entirely acceptable as a therapy for couples with unexplained non-conception, particularly when considering the risk of multiple pregnancies. While COS-IUI can be effective, the induction of more than one follicle does not significantly improve ongoing pregnancy rates but does increase the risk of multiple pregnancies. To minimize this risk, it is recommended that monofollicular growth be aimed for in all IUI cycles for unexplained non-conception, rather than multifollicular stimulation. This approach can help reduce the number of multiple pregnancies while still providing a viable treatment option for couples struggling with unexplained infertility.
